reason: The approved canonical design permits relationship-scoped field assessments, but draft.1 constrained field_assessments[].entity_id to A2-ENT identifiers only.
correction: Retain the approved entity_id property name for dictionary compatibility and allow A2-REL identifiers only when scope is relationship. Person and organisation scopes continue to require A2-ENT identifiers; record scope continues to require null.
scope_impact: Backward-compatible correction to the unpromoted draft schema. No business field, CRM mapping, source policy, integration or external action is approved.
